source_caption_text:
She really stood up there and rapped the entire track faster than the studio version...Rolling Loud was not ready for this 😤🔥

Ms. Lauryn Hill delivered a standout performance of her 1998 classic “Lost Ones” at Rolling Loud Miami 2024. Backed by a full live arrangement, Hill performed the track with rapid-fire delivery and strong breath control, bringing the energy of the original recording to the festival stage. The performance quickly drew attention online, with fans praising her vocal control, stage presence, and ability to recreate one of her most iconic tracks live.
